title: A star begins
hook: Explore the evidence behind a cosmic question.

knows: Light and gravity help astronomers study the universe.
doesNotKnow: Stars form when dense regions in molecular clouds collapse under gravity. The collapsing material heats up and can develop into a protostar before sustained core fusion begins.

misconception: A learner may choose: In completely empty space without matter
objective: Use the visual model to reason about: Where do stars form?

claims.text: Question, correct answer and explanation: Where do stars form? In dense regions of gas and dust clouds. Stars form when dense regions in molecular clouds collapse under gravity. The collapsing material heats up and can develop into a protostar before sustained core fusion begins.
Visual caption: A cloud forms a protostar. The SVG is a conceptual illustration, not measured data or a scale model.
